InternalResultsPage.description:
The internal mirror (LLD B7.8): capped by ``limit`` instead of paged, and told when the cap cut rows, so an
AI tool can say the data was truncated instead of presenting a partial list as complete.
InternalResultsPage.title: InternalResultsPage

post.description: Appends a correction that supersedes the result. The original row is kept; no patient-svc call is made.

get.description:
Batch for list rows: latest eGFR, category, sparkline and attention flags. One entry per requested id, in
request order; an id with no results has ``has_results: false``.

Catalog for the lab form preview: units with exact factors, plausibility limit and reference ranges.
The server stays authoritative; this only lets the browser show the flag while typing.
